Veterans | Congressman Raul Ruiz Skip to main content Español Veterans Image “Veterans in our communities and all across the United States have served our country honorably and deserve our unwavering support. While we can never fully repay our veterans for their service to our nation, we have an obligation to work together as Democrats and Republicans to ensure they have access to the high-quality care and receive benefits they have earned and deserve.” - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. Securing Health Care for Our Veterans For years, Dr. Ruiz has worked in honor of local veteran Jennifer Kepner from Cathedral City to help veterans who have been exposed to burn pits and other toxins during their service receive the health care they need. Over the years, he’s introduced nine bills on this front that have become law. Most recently, he worked to make the Honoring our PACT Act become law. Included in the landmark package are his three bills that will assist over 3.5 million veterans in obtaining the health care they’ve earned, deserve, and desperately need. Helping Veterans Experiencing Homelessness After serving and sacrificing for our nation no veteran should have to go without a home and the support they need. Dr. Ruiz has had five bills signed into law to help improve resources and access to care for veterans when they return home from their service. He’s also introduced the Health Care for Homeless Veterans Act to expand access to the VA’s outreach services so that all veterans experiencing homelessness can access the resources, support, and care they need as they transition back to civilian life. Getting Veterans Their Earned Benefits Dr. Ruiz will always fight to get veterans the benefits, care, and recognition they’ve earned and deserve. His office has helped recover medals and awards for over 150 veterans. In the 117th Congress, he’s also helped veterans secure $1.6 million in benefits from the VA that were previously denied to them. Dr. Ruiz also is working closely with Republican Representative Gus Bilirakis (FL) to help disabled veterans access their full, earned benefits by introducing the Major Richard Star Act. Health Care | Congressman Raul Ruiz Skip to main content Español Health Care Image “As an emergency medicine physician, I know how important it is for people I serve to have access to quality, affordable health care. I will always fight to lower costs for families, protect Medicare for seniors, and find bipartisan solutions that will improve our nation’s health care system for all.” - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. Making Health Care More Affordable In Congress, Dr. Ruiz has consistently worked to lower health care costs for American families. Most recently, Dr. Ruiz voted for the Inflation Reduction Act, which became law in 2022, lowering prescription drug costs and insulin costs for seniors and reducing health care costs for families with insurance through Covered California. Dr. Ruiz has also gotten legislation signed into law to strengthen and expand Medicaid. His bill, the Medicaid Services Investment and Accountability Act, became law on April 18, 2019, and helps children and families suffering from mental health disorders access the care they need. Protecting and Strengthening Medicare Dr. Ruiz understands that after a lifetime of hard work, our nation’s seniors deserve access to quality, affordable health care. That is why he is a staunch defender of Medicare and has worked to strengthen it over the years. His bipartisan bill, the Protecting Seniors' Access to Medicare Act, became law on February 9, 2018, as part of the Bipartisan Budget Act of 2018. This law helps seniors access the health care they need by eliminating the Independent Payment Advisory Board tasked with reducing Medicare spending. He has also had legislation signed into law that will help seniors avoid harmful coverage gaps that leave them without access to health care just because they inadvertently missed their initial sign-up period for Medicare. His bill, the Beneficiary Enrollment Notification and Eligibility Simplification (BENES) Act became law on December 27, 2020, as part of the Consolidated Appropriations Act 2021. Immigration | Congressman Raul Ruiz Skip to main content Español Immigration Image “Immigrants are making tremendous contributions to our economy and military here in our region. As the son of immigrants, I’ve worked across party lines for bipartisan immigration solutions that secure our border, protect workers and business, and include an earned pathway to citizenship for families and Dreamers who are working and contributing to our country.” - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. Protecting Dreamers Dr. Ruiz understands the crucial role Dreamers play in our economy and society, as they contribute nearly $42 billion per year to our economy. That is why, as Chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus from 2021 – 2022, Dr. Ruiz led efforts to pass the Dream and Promise Act and other legislation to secure a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers. Restoring Fairness Dr. Ruiz has consistently worked toward common-sense bipartisan solutions to fix our broken immigration system. As Chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus from 2021 – 2022, Dr. Ruiz worked to pass legislation like the Farm Workforce Modernization Act out of the House with bipartisan support, which would help stabilize our region’s labor supply by providing farmworkers who have put food on Americans’ kitchen tables with an earned pathway to citizenship. He’s also cosponsored legislation such as the U.S. Citizenship Act, which would provide many Dreamers, TPS holders, and farmworkers with a three-year path to citizenship. Smart Border Management Dr. Ruiz supports securing our borders with smart, modern technology while maintaining professionalism and humanity in our immigration system. Dr. Ruiz voted for the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, which includes $1.4 billion for construction and modernization projects at land ports of entry along the U.S.-Mexico border. Dr. Ruiz has also voted to make smart and effective investments in border security and humanitarian efforts at the southern border with the Fiscal Year 2023 Homeland Security funding package. Senior Citizens | Congressman Raul Ruiz Skip to main content Español Senior Citizens Image “I will always stand up for our local seniors, from protecting crucial programs like Social Security and Medicare to bringing down health care costs and prescription drugs. We have an obligation to take care of them and ensure they receive the benefits they have earned and planned on in their golden years.” - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. Protecting Medicare & Social Security Dr. Ruiz understands that Medicare and Social Security are commitments made to our nation’s seniors and that they must be upheld and protected. That is why he has consistently cosponsored the Social Security 2100 Act, a comprehensive update to Social Security benefits that strengthens the program for years to come, increases benefits for current and new beneficiaries, and protects the program against inflation. The legislation also repeals the Windfall Eliminating Provision and the Government Pension Offset, which have unfairly affected public servants for years. His office has also helped local families and seniors secure more than $22.4 million in benefits previously denied by the Social Security Administration, Medicare, and other federal agencies. Improving Health Care Access for Seniors As a physician, Dr. Ruiz has consistently worked to improve access to quality, affordable care for our nation’s seniors. Over the years, he has advocated to expand Medicare coverage for dental and vision services. Additionally, Dr. Ruiz advocated and voted for the Inflation Reduction Act, which lowers prescription drug and insulin costs for seniors. On top of that, Dr. Ruiz has introduced legislation to tackle health care scams that target seniors with his bill, the Protecting Seniors from Health Care Fraud Act. Jobs and Economy | Congressman Raul Ruiz Skip to main content Español Jobs and Economy Image “Creating good-paying jobs and boosting our economic growth guide my work in Congress. As a physician, I’ve taken a pragmatic approach to grow our economy and work in a bipartisan way to lower costs, create jobs, and help small business owners succeed.” - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. Creating Good-Paying Jobs One of Dr. Ruiz's priorities is to create unionized, good-paying jobs in our communities while growing our economy. Since 2014, Dr. Ruiz has worked to drive the creation of clean energy jobs that will help employ hundreds of thousands of people in the region with his bill, the Renewable Energy Jobs Act. Dr. Ruiz also voted for the bipartisan the Creating Helpful Incentives to Produce Semiconductors and Science Act of 2022 (CHIPS Act), a historic investment in American science, technological, and manufacturing industries to bring union jobs back to our communities. He also advocated and voted for the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to strengthen our country's infrastructure and create at least 17,000 new jobs in California. Lowering Costs for Families Dr. Ruiz understands how high prices in the grocery aisle and at the gas pump are weighing heavily on working families in our communities and across the country, especially on those living paycheck to paycheck. That is why Congressman Ruiz voted for the Lower Food and Fuel Costs Act to bring down costs for families. Also, Dr. Ruiz advocated and voted for the historical Inflation Reduction Act to bring down health care and energy costs for our local families. Supporting Small Businesses Dr. Ruiz believes that local small businesses are the drivers of job creation and the lifeblood of our economy. In 2015, Congressman Ruiz worked with the Small Business Administration to open an SBA office in Palm Desert to support small business owners and aspiring entrepreneurs across the Inland Empire, creating new, sustainable, good-paying jobs in our region. Energy and Environment | Congressman Raul Ruiz Skip to main content Español Energy and Environment Image “As an emergency medicine physician, I have witnessed firsthand that the environment is a key determinant of health. That is why I am fighting to invest in a clean energy economy that creates good-paying jobs, protects our environment, and increases our energy independence.” - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. Fighting the Impacts of Climate Change Dr. Ruiz understands the importance of addressing climate change head-on with commonsense solutions. He advocated and voted for the bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act – known as the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law – to make bold investments in our communities’ infrastructure and to combat the climate crisis. This bipartisan package includes $80 million to invest in solar power research and development projects to create good-paying, clean energy jobs across the country. Dr. Ruiz also helped bring the Inflation Reduction Act across the finish line, which makes the single largest investment ever in combatting climate change while bringing clean energy manufacturing jobs to local communities. On top of that, Dr. Ruiz has advocated to curb harmful emissions by cosponsoring the Climate Action Now Act to ensure the U.S. meets its emission goals established under the Paris Climate Agreement. Addressing the Crisis at the Salton Sea Growing up in Coachella, Dr. Ruiz understands firsthand the harmful, daily effects of the Salton Sea on our local environment and public health. For years, he has prioritized addressing the environmental and public health crisis at the Salton Sea, most recently securing a $250 million federal investment to the Sea through the Inflation Reduction Act. This funding, along with the $30 million agreement he helped broker between the federal government and the State of California and the $6.7 million he’s secured for additional projects over the years, will help clean up the Sea and improve our air quality. Energía y medio ambiente | Congressman Raul Ruiz Pasar al contenido principal English Energía y medio ambiente Imagen "Como médico de urgencias, he sido testigo directo de que el medio ambiente es un determinante clave de la salud. Por eso estoy luchando para invertir en una economía de energía limpia que cree empleos bien remunerados, proteja nuestro medio ambiente y aumente nuestra independencia energética." - Congressman Raul Ruiz, M.D. COMBATIR LOS EFECTOS DEL CAMBIO CLIMÁTICO El Dr. Ruiz entiende la importancia de abordar el cambio climático de frente con soluciones de sentido común. Defendió y votó a favor de la Ley bipartidista de Inversión en Infraestructuras y Empleo -conocida como Ley Bipartidista de Infraestructuras- para realizar inversiones audaces en las infraestructuras de nuestras comunidades y combatir la crisis climática. Este paquete bipartidista incluye $80 millones de dólares para invertir en proyectos de investigación y desarrollo de energía solar para crear empleos bien remunerados y de energía limpia en todo el país. El Dr. Ruiz también ayudó a llevar la Ley de Reducción de la Inflación a través de la línea de meta, que hace la inversión más grande jamás en la lucha contra el cambio climático al tiempo que trae puestos de trabajo de fabricación de energía limpia a las comunidades locales. Además de eso, el Dr. Ruiz ha abogado por frenar las emisiones nocivas copatrocinando la Ley de Acción Climática Ahora para garantizar que Estados Unidos cumpla sus objetivos de emisiones establecidos en el Acuerdo Climático de París. HACER FRENTE A LA CRISIS EN EL SALTON SEA Al haber crecido en Coachella, el Dr. Ruiz conoce de primera mano los efectos nocivos y cotidianos del Salton Sea en nuestro medio ambiente local y en la salud pública. Durante años, ha dado prioridad a abordar la crisis medioambiental y de salud pública en el Salton Sea, y más recientemente ha conseguido una inversión federal de $250 millones de dólares para el Salton Sea a través de la Ley de Reducción de la Inflación.
